instruction: You are given an axisymmetric cylinder template `/home/user/Desktop/cylinder_transform.inp`. Complete the following from the command line: 1. Modify and generate `/home/user/Desktop/transform.inp`: Please save the final input file as /home/user/Desktop/transform.inp. - Transform all nodes into a cylindrical coordinate system centered at the origin - Apply radial pressure `10 MPa` on the inner wall - Apply `UY=0` on the bottom edge - Constrain circumferential displacement `UT=0` on outer-wall nodes 2. Submit the job and write a post-processing script to parse `transform.dat`: - Extract inner-wall radial displacement `UR` - Extract outer-wall radial displacement `UR` - Extract maximum absolute circumferential displacement `|UT|` over the whole model - Write to `/home/user/Desktop/summary.txt` in this format: `inner_ur,outer_ur,max_abs_ut` [Software] Run `ccx --version` or invoke the installed `ccx` binary from a terminal.
